reviewFix.details: Name display and uniqueness semantics now match SPEC-002. Fake and Room mutation receipts use distinct logical operation keys, replay only successful same-operation results, and reject different-operation token reuse without mutation. Existing Room schema column is reused; no schema change.
reviewFix.formatting: Pinned ktlint 1.5.0 format and follow-up check passed on all three production files.

findings.summary: Mutation receipts identify only a broad entity type, allowing reuse across different operations to return false success without mutation.
findings.requiredAction: Add operation-specific receipt identity in Room and the fake, align retry semantics, and add shared fake and Room acceptance coverage.

findings.summary: Name validation collapses whitespace before display storage and length validation instead of applying those rules to the trimmed display name.
findings.requiredAction: Preserve trimmed display whitespace, validate its 1-40 length, collapse repeated whitespace only for the case-insensitive uniqueness key, and add boundary/display coverage.

findings.summary: Approved traceability names missing tests and omits meaningful coverage for operation-token misuse and persisted custom record identity.
findings.requiredAction: Add or rename acceptance tests to match actual coverage and update approved specification mappings.
